<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?route source="north"?>
<!-- Preserve platform-owned processing instructions across native plural rules. -->
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<?after-doctype owner="platform"?>
<plist version="1.0">
  <?plist-state mode="protected"?>
  <dict>
    <?before-message route="dock"?>
    <key>dock.signals</key>
    <?between-message owner="structure"?>
    <dict>
      <?before-pattern owner="structure"?>
      <key>NSStringLocalizedFormatKey</key>
      <?between-pattern owner="structure"?>
      <string>%#@signals@ near shore</string>

      <?before-rule owner="structure"?>
      <key>signals</key>
      <dict>
        <?before-type owner="structure"?>
        <key>NSStringFormatSpecTypeKey</key>
        <?between-type owner="structure"?>
        <string>NSStringPluralRuleType</string>
        <key>NSStringFormatValueTypeKey</key>
        <?between-value-type owner="structure"?>
        <string>ld</string>

        <?before-one owner="structure"?>
        <key>one</key>
        <?between-one owner="structure"?>
        <string>%ld steady beacon</string>
        <?before-other owner="structure"?>
        <key>other</key>
        <?between-other owner="structure"?>
        <string><![CDATA[%ld steady beacons]]></string>
        <?after-other owner="structure"?>
      </dict>

      <?before-extra owner="structure"?>
      <key>futureRulePriority</key>
      <?between-extra owner="structure"?>
      <integer>7</integer>
      <?after-extra owner="structure"?>
    </dict>
    <?after-message route="dock"?>
  </dict>
</plist>
<?document-end source="north"?>
